key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: Gradual over hours to days. LOCATION: Upper respiratory tract. DURATION: 3-7 days. CHARACTER: Nasal congestion, sore throat, cough. AGGRAVATING: Cold air, talking. RELIEVING: Rest, fluids, humidified air. TIMING: Acute, self-limiting. SEVERITY: Mild to moderate (3-6/10). ASSOCIATED SYMPTOMS: Nasal congestion, sore throat, cough, sneezing, fatigue, low-grade fever. KEY POSITIVES: Nasal congestion, sore throat, cough. KEY NEGATIVES: No chest pain, no wheezing (unless reactive airway disease).
